description: This PHP source file defines the class VacancySearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class. It provides properties and methods to encapsulate search filter parameters for vacancy listings within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes filtering options such as job title ID, employee number, vacancy status, name, publication state, and vacancy IDs, along with allowed sort fields.

classes.name: VacancySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object used to specify filtering criteria for vacancy searches within the recruitment module, allowing consumers to set and retrieve various filter parameters like job title, status, and publication state.
